name: io.github.av-leschinskiy/moodle-mcp
description: Moodle MCP server for teachers: review assignment submissions, grade and give feedback; SSO login

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where moodle-mcp-login saves the token (path is resolved via homedir())

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Web service token override (CI / smoke tests)

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout of a single API request (ms)

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Chrome/Chromium binary for moodle-mcp-login (looked up in PATH by default)

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: 1/true/yes/on enables debug output to stderr and debug level in the host log channel
